path.title: 2024-11-15: BHP test 3,015 psia (measured static); model below measured static pressure

svg.text: Line: modelled flowing BHP; band: tubing and basis sensitivity; diamonds: BHP test (measured static); bars: permit minus reported maximum.
Pressure basis: H-10 and permit pressures read as psig (RRC H-10 reports gauge pressure (verification)); BHP tests read as psig.
Calendar-day average rate; it understates the rate while the well is actually injecting, so friction is understated and the modelled pressure reads high.
Dashed: permit-equivalent bottomhole pressure (restates the permit limit at depth; not an independent constraint).
Screening only: not a regulatory approval, compliance finding or safe-operating determination.
